root_cause: Path-only agent preflight can miss CMS-to-website, Brain-contract and Supabase schema consumer dependencies; the existing planner had no automatic cross-domain impact projection.
failed_approaches: Independent file path does not prove independent shared runtime contract
Skipping downstream tests based only on first path directory
Creating additional schedules or queues to handle missing scope
fix: Project deterministic cross-domain dependency impact from changedPaths in the existing predictive controller and expose it on every agent plan including capacity holds.
prevention_rule: Unknown paths receive full cross-lane preflight; advisory classification never waives hygiene, Required, CodeQL, provider preview, RLS, CLS, tenant isolation, financial parity or production readback. No second scheduler, queue, incident authority or writer.

invariants: Brain shared contracts propagate to dependent Portal and Heartbeat
Supabase migrations propagate to runtime consumers
Unknown or unsafe paths require full early preflight
One active writer and bounded queue semantics remain unchanged

terminal_rule: Candidate only until exact-head Required/hygiene/CodeQL, protected merge, main and provider readback plus existing skill projection; wider #4661 remains independently open.
